content.scenario: A consumer, Ramesh, files a complaint with the District Commission in Chennai against a company alleging a defect in a product. The Commission admits the complaint and refers a copy to the company, directing them to respond within 30 days.
content.outcome: The company responds to the complaint, denying the allegations. The District Commission proceeds to settle the consumer dispute and may require the complainant to deposit fees for payment to a laboratory for analysis or testing of the product. The Commission will then issue an appropriate order under section 39 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
